storySection.title: Our Story
storySection.subtitle: The journey of Thunder Stack Studio
content: Thunder Stack Studio was born from a passion to preserve and celebrate the rich cultural heritage of the Philippines through the medium of interactive gaming. Founded in 2026 at Caraga State University's main campus in Butuan City, we recognized the untapped potential of Filipino folklore, traditions, and cultural narratives in the global gaming landscape.

Our journey began with a simple yet powerful vision: to create games that not only entertain but also educate players about the beauty and depth of Filipino culture. We saw an opportunity to bridge the gap between traditional storytelling and modern interactive entertainment, making our heritage accessible to both local and international audiences.

As pioneers in the Caraga region's game development community, we're committed to nurturing local talent and establishing Butuan City as a hub for cultural gaming innovation. Our team combines technical expertise with deep cultural knowledge to create authentic, engaging experiences that honor our ancestors while inspiring future generations.
